summary: Second run today: all 4 tier lists re-fetched, 80/80 each, 0 letter moves. Archon re-clustered survivability within the day - 26 of 40 letters merged. Archon tank DPS cut merged.

sources.detail: All 6 live pages re-fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200, 192-340 KB uncompressed; r.jina.ai untried (IP-403 on these hosts). Parsed from the tier-list table: the first <td> of each row is the letter, matched WHOLE-CELL against the registered icyveins scale (S+|S|A+|A|B+|B|C, plus TBD as explicit null) rather than by a \b-anchored regex, which is the trap that read 'A+' as 'A' on 38 rows in an earlier run; each tier-list-entry's FIRST img alt looked up WHOLE against the roster, never split at a space. Per-page counts printed and reconciled against 27+7+6=40 BEFORE any merge: raid 27/7/6 and M+ 27/7/6 = 80 rows, 0 unmatched. Upstream still publishes TWO M+ DPS specs as "TBD" - Windwalker Monk and Frost Death Knight - and both are carried as explicit null, never as a stale letter: they read "-" and sit outside the consensus mean, which is the same call the earlier run made when the withdrawal first appeared. All 80 letters are byte-identical to stored, so nothing was merged and specs.json is untouched by this source. Page self-dates re-read and unchanged: raid DPS dateModified 2026-08-23T13:09Z, raid healer 2026-08-24T00:44Z, raid tank 2026-08-08, all three M+ pages 2026-08-23 - identical to the stored published values and to the pre-agent published-evidence artifact. Era-verified s2 on all six: the raid HEALER page still TITLES itself '(Patch 12.0.7 / Midnight)' while its body reads 'Midnight Season 2' throughout and its changelog records '24 Aug. 2026: Updated for the start of RWF Mythic progression' and '13 Aug. 2026: Further updated for Midnight Season 2 launch' - body over title, the blue-tracker precedent, so its seasonVerified stays s2 and it keeps feeding the raid consensus. NOTE ON THE DATES: the stored snapshot was already 2026-08-25 because an earlier run today (startedAt 11:24Z) refreshed this source; tonight's fetch re-verified it live rather than advancing it, which is why previousAsOf equals newAsOf on a success row.

Both pages re-fetched live, HTTP 200, 159/166 KB. Parsed from the tier__tier / tier__title blocks with each entry's data-original-title read as the 'Spec Class' string and looked up whole: raid 40 rows (S 6 / A 11 / B 17 / C 6), M+ 40 rows (S 2 / A 13 / B 21 / C 4), 0 unmatched, 0 letters moved against stored. The M+ page again carries a SECOND tierlist - the dungeon-difficulty block - and it was rejected by ROSTER MATCH, not by position: its eight entries (King's Rest, Ruby Life Pools, Voidscar Arena, The Blinding Vale, Den of Nalorakk, Murder Row, Temple of Sethraliss, Altar of Fangs) map to no spec and were reported as unmatched rather than silently dropped. Era-verified s2 from the body: both pages name Season 2 and Patch 12.1, and the M+ page's byline is Tactyks. Page self-dates read off the body: raid 'Last Updated 10th August 2026', M+ '13th August 2026' - both older than the 08-25 snapshot, which is expected for a list that is edited episodically, and neither is stored as `published` for this source. Nothing merged; specs.json untouched by this source. previousAsOf equals newAsOf because the earlier run today (11:24Z) already stamped the snapshot 2026-08-25; this run re-verified it live.

All 6 pages re-fetched with the FULL browser header set (a UA-only request is Cloudflare-403; r.jina.ai is IP-403 on /guide/* since 2026-08-03 and was not tried), HTTP 200, 19-95 KB compressed. Parsed the documented way: unescape \/ across the whole document FIRST, then take the [tier-list=rows] ... [/tier-list] block - never anchoring on WH.markup.printHtml(, which is the decoy that returned 0 rows for the raid-healer page in an earlier run. Exactly one tier-list block per page tonight. Tier labels matched with tolerant whitespace ([tier-label bg=q3]B [/tier-label] carries a trailing space) and specs resolved from the [spec-badge=<spec>-<class>] kebab slug, which sidesteps the two-word-class split entirely. Counts reconciled before merging: raid 27/7/6, M+ 27/7/6 = 80 rows, 0 unmatched. 0 letters moved. M+ DPS again publishes A+ (2 specs) and no S, which the wowhead scale supports. Page self-dates re-read: raid DPS 2026-08-14T21:28, raid healer 2026-08-18T09:12, raid tank 2026-08-14T20:57, all three M+ pages 2026-08-18 - identical to stored `published` and to the pre-agent published-evidence artifact. Era-verified s2: every title reads 'for Midnight Season 2'. Nothing merged. previousAsOf equals newAsOf because the earlier run today already stamped 2026-08-25; this run re-verified live.

All 6 aggregate pages re-fetched, HTTP 200, and parsed from <script id="__NEXT_DATA__"> at props.pageProps.page.specTierListSection.tierLists - the metric:'throughput' list for raid and metric:'score' for M+, never the default popularity grouping (each page carries all three: popularity, throughput, survivability). Every entry resolved from its icon 'Class-Spec' token rather than the display name, which is what maps 'BeastMastery Hunter' and 'DemonHunter-Devourer'; tiers[].entries is a list OF LISTS and was flattened. Counts: raid 26 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank, M+ 27 + 7 + 6 = 79 rows, 0 unmatched, 0 letters moved against stored. The one gap is FIRE MAGE, still absent from Archon's Season-2 raid DPS list entirely (it has no rankings row either); its stored raid archon rating is already an explicit null, so nothing was invented and nothing stale is standing. Page lastUpdated stamps: the three raid pages 2026-08-25T12:00Z, the three M+ pages 2026-08-24T12:00Z. Era-verified s2 (raid pages name Patch 12.1 / the Venomous Abyss encounter set, M+ pages name Season 2). Nothing merged. previousAsOf equals newAsOf because the earlier run today already stamped 2026-08-25.

Archon's Season-2 encounter rebuild has NOT moved since last night and was again deliberately not merged. All 17 encounters were re-enumerated from the aggregate pages' encounterOptions (9 raid bosses: Nek'zali, Sentinels, Vashnik, Explorers, Sszorak, The Twin Fangs, The Coiled Altar, Ula'tek, Nymrissa; 8 dungeons: Altar of Fangs, Den of Nalorakk, Kings' Rest, Murder Row, Ruby Life Pools, Sethraliss, The Blinding Vale, Voidscar Arena) and all 51 pages (17 x DPS/healer/tank) were fetched fresh, HTTP 200, 0 failures. Result is exactly last night's: every dungeon complete at 40 tier rows (320 total), Nek'zali 39, Lost Explorers 27, and the other SEVEN raid bosses empty across all three roles - 386 rows against the 619 stored. Rewriting the file with 386 would be a 38% row drop (limit 25%) and below the 440 rows.min floor, and would publish a Season-2 fight view holding two of nine bosses, so data/encounter-tiers.json is left byte-identical with its season stamp at s1 and the Fight selector correctly hidden. The Per- page snapshots were again NOT advanced, because nothing was ingested. What DID change tonight is the recorded observation: both Per- page entries in sources.json now carry seasonVerified s2 (was s1), because the pages I fetched describe Season 2 content - Venomous Abyss bosses and the S2 dungeon set. Those pages are ancillary:true, so they sit outside sourceSeasonOk and aheadSeasonFor and this moves no consensus, no forecast and no frozen-lane record; it is the honest record of what the page said at refresh, exactly as the skill requires for ancillary pages.

MERGED, and the headline is that Archon RE-CLUSTERED this list within the same day: 26 of the 40 letters differ from the ones the 11:24Z run merged four hours earlier. The read is the metric:'survivability' tierList on the three RAID aggregate pages (lastUpdated 2026-08-25T12:00Z), the same parse path as always and no per-boss substitution - the 2026-08-21 measurement settles that per-boss survivability is a fight artifact. Two checks before merging. (1) INTERNAL CONSISTENCY: every tier-list entry carries its own numeric value and 39 of 40 match that page's specRankingsSection.table survivability column to the decimal (Arcane 84.8 vs 84.823848), and within each role page the letters are monotone in the number - so tonight's letters are what THIS document says, not a mis-selected list. (2) The letters do NOT match this build's popularity or throughput lists (11/39 agreement each), so last night's differing letters were not a wrong-list read either; the clustering itself moved. The likely driver is visible in the DPS pool: FIRE MAGE has appeared in the survivability list at exactly 100.0%, an extreme new anchor for a Ckmeans clustering, while still having no rankings row at all. Fire Mage is therefore the ONE spec held back - 39 of 40 merged - because a letter with no visible parse basis is precisely the shape refresh-metrics records as untrustworthy, and spec.survivability carries a per-spec asOf so its stale 2026-08-17 row self-labels in the drawer rather than being silently pooled. Merged distribution S 8 / A 16 / B 12 / C 4 across 39. Coverage date stays 2026-08-25 (it was already today's date from the earlier run), which is why previousAsOf equals newAsOf on a success row.

Half of this requirement advanced tonight and half is still blocked by the same single spec. MERGED: the six TANK rows of '95th pct DPS (Mythic)' from the raid-tank page, which is COMPLETE at 6/6 and whose rank pool - (Tank, raid, that name) - now contains nothing but Season-2 values. That is the archon-hps precedent applied on its own terms rather than by coupling: metricRanks pools within (role, bracket, name), so a complete tank cut is independently publishable and leaving it at Season-1 numbers to keep company with a held DPS cut would be the worse error. Moves 1.1-10.6% (Guardian 108,730 -> 97,185 the largest), all far inside maxValueMovePct, n taken from each row's parses column (Blood DK 193, Prot Paladin 66, Brewmaster 46, Guardian 36, Prot Warrior 26, Vengeance 9). HELD: the 26 raid DPS rows, for the third night, because FIRE MAGE still has no row in specRankingsSection.table.data (26 of 27 DPS) and there is no way to write 'unrated' for a NUMBER the way apply-ratings writes an explicit null for a letter - one stale Season-1 intruder inside a 27-row rank pool with no provenance key would shift every spec below it. Values read but not merged for the record: 0.1-20.0% moves, none approaching the 60% limit, and the sample is thinner tonight than last night on the tail (Affliction 2 parses, Survival 4, Frost Mage 5). Coverage date is the 25th-freshest of 33 rows and correctly stays 2026-08-16. Merge wholesale on the first night Archon covers all 27 DPS specs; the requirement's standing-red label still describes a 'totalParses 0' state that stopped being the reason days ago and should be rewritten then.

Re-fetched and re-verified, nothing to merge. Same split as last night, and for the same measured reason. The 40 M+ rows and the 13 raid healer+tank rows were re-parsed and are byte-identical to stored (the M+ pages are the same 08-24T12:00Z build; the raid healer/tank tables are unchanged too), so nothing needed merging there. The 26 raid DPS rows are again HELD: Fire Mage has no row on the Season-2 raid DPS page, and a group that must sum to 100 cannot absorb one stale Season-1 share - the merged 26 sum to exactly 100.0 at source and the stored intruder would push the published raid-DPS group to about 101.5, a visibly broken series rather than a merely stale one. Shape-checked as the recipe requires before deciding: every value a plausible percentage, all six (role x bracket) groups summing to 100.00 at source, and no row equal to that spec's 95th-pct DPS or M+ score - the check that once caught DPS magnitudes landing under unit '%'. Coverage date is the 60th-freshest of 80 rows and correctly stays 2026-08-16. Unblocks together with archon-metrics on the first night Archon lists all 27 raid DPS specs.

Both JSON API endpoints fetched with plain curl - no headers, no proxy, no auth - and the wowmeta.com HTML (a stale March prerender) was not touched. manifest.json snapshotDate reads 2026-08-11 and, per the 2026-08-04 pinned-manifest lesson, the rankings file was fetched and DIFFED rather than trusted to that stamp: rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json returned 44 blocks, of which the whitelisted categoryType dps|hps|tank + sortField lowerBound + keyRange undefined selection gives exactly 27+7+6 = 40 rows (the melee/ranged blocks are subsets of dps and are excluded, never merely blacklisting 'dungeon'). All 40 lowerBound values AND all 40 numberOfCharacters counts are byte-identical to stored at 1 dp, so upstream is genuinely frozen, not merely stamped frozen. Nothing merged; the coverage date correctly does not move. This is the OWNER-ACCEPTED standing red on this requirement - it clears when WoWMeta re-runs its pipeline, and must not be acked away.

All 27 DPS charts requested via talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with up to 3 attempts each. 17 returned data and the SAME 10 specs as the 2026-08-20 measurement returned the 76-byte {"status": "error"} body on every attempt (Havoc, Devourer, Balance, Feral, Augmentation, Devastation, Windwalker, Retribution, Arms, Fury) while control specs succeeded interleaved in the same minutes, so the endpoint is healthy and those specs simply have not been re-simmed. Every one of the 17 carries simc_settings.tier MID2 (read off the chart, never assumed) against MID1 in all 26 stored profiles, and their own chart timestamps are 2026-08-19 (14) and 2026-08-24 (3). NOTHING WAS MERGED, which is the only correct outcome: a source's fight-profile pool may hold exactly one sim tier, MID2 measured a mean 1.79x MID1 (and percentiles are scale-invariant so 'normalising' is a no-op), and fightLabels pools every DPS profile with no provenance key - so merging 17 MID2 specs would hand every 'strong' label to the re-simmed specs and publish which specs bloodmallet has re-simmed as if it were spec strength. Adopt wholesale or not at all, and 17 is also below the 19-of-26 row-drop floor. fightProfile.asOf stays each spec's own chart date (2026-07-08), the age gate stays red, and that red is the honest signal that upstream has not finished re-simming.

Adopting it would mix two sim tiers in one rank pool AND drop 26 rows to 18, a 31% row drop past the 25% limit. So nothing was merged, stored values stay byte-identical at 2026-08-08, and the staleness red stays as the honest signal. This is the OWNER-ACCEPTED standing red; it clears when a complete Live MID2 report lands - which now looks close, since both reports are simulating on the same live build.

A full discovery sweep with no transcript lane available, and one queue addition. DISCOVERY: all 44 unique YouTube channels behind the 79 transcribable creator entries polled via the RSS endpoint, 44/44 HTTP 200, 0 failures, 660 videos. The seen-set was rebuilt as the union of the four MACHINE lanes (pending-transcripts seen[] 549, skipped[] 409, videos[] 0, plus every youtu.be id cited by a take or metaNote) - never by regex over log prose - leaving 149 unseen videos, all of them inside the current cycle (bound = the OLDEST date in ptr-builds.json, 2026-06-18, taken as a date and not an index). TRANSCRIPTS: none were available to distil. transcript-fetch/summary.json reads verdict 'ok' with requested 0 - the deterministic step ran at 15:51:05Z against an empty queue - and this agent holds no transcript credentials and did not contact YouTube or any transcript API for captions. So 0 takes and 0 metaNotes were distilled, 0 superseded, and data/creator-takes.json is byte-identical. QUEUED: exactly one video, Obli's 'Talking shop about Blightfall + NEW UNHOLY BUGS!! / Unholy DK Midnight Update 12.1' (djVmUT8w0fU, 2026-08-25), whose media:description promises Blightfall's 'strengths and weaknesses in raid and M+' - a spec-strength read inside Obli's registered Frost/Unholy scope. The nightly queue is drained by Supadata against a 100-request MONTHLY budget, so the remaining 105 keyword-matching unseen videos were deliberately NOT queued: they are stream VODs, boss/dungeon guides, POV kill clips and build walkthroughs, all shapes with a long verified-skip record, recomputed from skipped[] rather than remembered: Bansherz 32, Tactyks 20, Megasett 19, NeekapHere 18, Dratnos 18 (6 of them RWF recap episodes, days 0-2 of this very race included), LBNinja7 13, Shindigg 11, Maximum 11, AutomaticJak 10 - plus Supatease, 19 of whose 39 skips are explicitly PvP-framed and therefore out of scope for this PvE tracker. Those ids were left UNSEEN rather than marked seen[], because a budget or triage dismissal is not a durable judgment and must remain reconsiderable - only distilled or transcript-verified videos leave the unseen pool.
